blocks.prompt: 6 If \(z_1 = 2 + i\), \(z_2 = 3 - 2i\), \(z_3 = 1 + 3i\) then express \(\dfrac{\overline{z_1}\,\overline{z_3}}{z_2}\) in the form of \(a + ib\).
blocks.explanation: Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke given kya hai: teen complex numbers \(z_1 = 2 + i\), \(z_2 = 3 - 2i\), \(z_3 = 1 + 3i\). Find karna hai \(\overline{z_1}\,\overline{z_3}/z_2\), aur jawab \(a + ib\) shakal mein. Kitab mein \(z_1\) aur \(z_3\) dono par conjugate ki line (bar) hai, \(z_2\) par nahin. Plan: (1) dono conjugates likhein, (2) unhein multiply karke aik number banayein, (3) \(z_2\) se divide karein, yani upar neeche \(\overline{z_2}\) se multiply karein, (4) \(a + ib\) mein likhein. Aik tasalli ki baat: agar aik hi bar poore product par hota tab bhi jawab yahi aata, kyun ke \(\overline{z_1 z_3} = \overline{z_1}\,\overline{z_3}\).
steps:
Step 1: Conjugates likhein
\[\overline{z_1} = 2 - i\]
\[\overline{z_3} = 1 - 3i\]
Kyun: Conjugate mein real part wahi rehta hai aur imaginary part ka sign badal jata hai. \(z_2\) par bar nahin, is liye usay waisa hi rakhein.

Step 2: Conjugates multiply karein
\[(2 - i)(1 - 3i)\]
\[= 2 - 6i - i + 3i^{2}\]
\[= 2 - 7i - 3\]
\[= -1 - 7i\]
Kyun: Har term ko har term se: \(2 \cdot 1 = 2\), \(2(-3i) = -6i\), \((-i)(1) = -i\), \((-i)(-3i) = 3i^2 = -3\). Real parts \(2 - 3 = -1\), imaginary \(-6i - i = -7i\).

Step 3: \(z_2\) ke conjugate se multiply karein
\[\dfrac{-1 - 7i}{3 - 2i} \cdot \dfrac{3 + 2i}{3 + 2i}\]
Kyun: \(\overline{z_2} = 3 + 2i\) se upar neeche multiply karne se neeche real number ban jayega aur value nahin badlegi.
Dhyan dein: Yahan \(\overline{z_2}\) sirf division ka aala (tool) hai; sawal mein \(z_2\) ka conjugate nahin manga gaya. Is ko Step 1 ke conjugates se mix mat karein.

Step 5: Neeche nikaalein
\[(3 - 2i)(3 + 2i) = 9 - 4i^{2}\]
\[= 9 + 4 = 13\]
Kyun: Difference of squares; neeche hamesha \(c^2 + d^2 = 9 + 4\) aata hai.

Step 6: \(a + ib\) shakal mein likhein
\[\dfrac{11 - 23i}{13} = \dfrac{11}{13} - \dfrac{23}{13}i\]
Kyun: Dono hisson ko alag alag 13 se divide kiya, to \(a = 11/13\) aur \(b = -23/13\).

Tasdeeq:
\[\tfrac{1}{13}(11 - 23i)(3 - 2i)\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{13}(33 - 91i + 46i^{2})\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{13}(-13 - 91i)\]
\[= -1 - 7i\]
Jawab ko \(z_2\) se multiply karke wapas numerator \(-1 - 7i\) mil gaya. Theek hai.
